x.description: N-dimensional array from which unique values will be extracted.

size.description: if specified, return only the first ``size`` sorted unique elements. If there are fewer unique elements than ``size`` indicates, the return value will be padded with ``fill_value``.

fill_value.description: when ``size`` is specified and there are fewer than the indicated number of elements, fill the remaining entries ``fill_value``. Defaults to the minimum unique value.

output.description: An array ``values`` of shape ``(n_unique,)`` containing the unique values from ``x``.
